map.→ 打开支座剪力（V = P / 2）工具: -> Open the support shear (V = P / 2) tool
map.剪力作用线通过的点，荷载过此点梁只弯不扭；开口薄壁截面尤其重要。: It is the point the shear force line passes through, so a load through it bends the beam without twisting; it matters especially for open thin-walled sections.
map.单腹板则全部剪力由其承担，V=P。: With a single web it carries all the shear, so V = P.
map.双腹板截面在竖向剪力下的腹板剪力分配。: How shear is distributed between the webs of a double-web section under vertical shear.
map.对称受剪时两腹板均分剪力。: Under symmetric shear both webs share the shear equally.
map.由端点集中力求悬臂梁挠度: Cantilever deflection from a tip concentrated force
map.简支梁跨中一个集中力时，两支座各承担一半。: With a single concentrated load at midspan, each support carries half.
map.箱梁、工字形截面剪力流初步估算。: Preliminary estimation of shear flow in box girders and I-shaped sections.
map.输入简支梁跨中集中力 P，计算两端支座的反力与剪力，跨中单点荷载时两支座各承担: Enter a midspan concentrated load P on a simply supported beam to compute the reactions and shear at both supports; under a single midspan load each support carries P/2, so the output support shear V = P/2 is used for support force analysis of simply supported beams under midspan loading.
map.：对称双腹板：每腹板 V=P/2=10/2=5 kN。: : with symmetric double webs, each web carries V = P/2 = 10/2 = 5 kN.
map.：若剪力中心偏离，可按腹板距中性轴位置加权分配，此处取对称均分近似。: : if the shear center is offset, the shear can be weighted by each web distance from the neutral axis; here the symmetric even split is used as an approximation.
